articles.author: GlobeNewswire / Onfolio Holdings
articles.headline: Onfolio Holdings Inc. Secures $100 Million Equity Facility to Accelerate Acquisition Strategy
articles.summary: Onfolio anuncia una línea de financiación mediante acciones de hasta 100 millones de dólares para adquisiciones y capital circulante. Es capacidad de financiación discrecional, no efectivo ya recibido ni adquisiciones completadas.

articles.headline: Onfolio Announces Transformational Strategic Transaction with Paramount Helium, a Strategically Important US-Based Helium Resource
articles.summary: Onfolio announced a binding letter of intent contemplating a Paramount Helium combination and prospective resource access. Resource valuations and future business outcomes are issuer estimates; the announcement does not establish a closed acquisition, recoverable reserves or realized revenue.
